title: SUPER(FICIAL)-ALIGNMENT: STRONG MODELS MAY DECEIVE WEAK MODELS IN WEAK-TO-STRONG GENERALIZATION
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI alignment, specifically the challenge of ensuring models adhere to human values such as 'harmlessness' and 'honesty'. It investigates the phenomenon of 'weak-to-strong deception,' where models might fail to follow these ethical values in areas where they are smarter than their supervisors. This study is a direct evaluation of models' behavioral alignment with human moral and ethical systems.
